title: Bohr, Bohr-Rogosinski, and Landau-Type Results for a Generalized Class of Harmonic Mappings
summary: In this paper, we study the Bohr phenomenon for a generalized subclass of harmonic mappings defined by a second-order differential inequality in the unit disk. Specifically, we consider the class $\mathcal{BH}_0(γ, δ)$, which extends several known subclasses of harmonic and analytic functions. By employing sharp coefficient estimates and growth results, we establish improved versions of Bohr-type inequalities, including refined Bohr radii and Bohr--Rogosinski radii for this class.
